reconfigure.title: Reconfigure PV Battery Optimizer
reconfigure.description: Change the evcc connection and the forecast and history sources. Options, saved plans and the learned PV correction are kept. The PV correction restarts if the PV forecast or the PV production sensor changes.

data_description.evcc_url: Base URL of your evcc instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:7070
data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
data_description.pv_energy_entity: Used to learn the error of the PV forecast.
data_description.house_energy_entity: Total household consumption (kWh, with long-term statistics).
data_description.ev_energy_entity: Optional: subtracted from the house consumption, EV charging is taken from evcc instead.

error.no_battery: evcc does not report a battery state of charge.

abort.already_configured: This evcc instance is already configured.
abort.no_pv_forecast: No supported PV forecast integration (Forecast.Solar, Solcast, Open-Meteo Solar Forecast) is set up.

data.wear_cost: Battery wear cost per discharged kWh
data.ev_charge_kw: EV charge power for planned sessions
data.load_history_days: Days of history for load forecast

data_description.grid_charge_kw: Power the battery actually charges with in evcc's charge mode. evcc's sonnen template uses maxchargepower (default 3300 W) for this.
data_description.feedin_price: Used when evcc has no feed-in tariff configured.
data_description.pv_safety_factor: Applied on top of the learned correction. Below 1 = plan more conservatively.
data_description.soc_step_kwh: SoC step of the optimizer. Smaller = more precise charge amounts but more CPU (0.05 kWh: ~1.5 s per 48 h plan on a fast machine, several seconds on a Raspberry Pi).
data_description.min_benefit: Hold or grid charging is only planned if it saves at least this much per 15 minutes compared with normal operation. Avoids switching modes for negligible gains.
